name: Shark
role: Apex. Sets the plan every wave; everyone else reads its lane and reacts.
home: Its own lane plus a buffer band; changes every wave
habit: One per wave. Never enters from the same edge or travels the same direction two waves in a row. Picks an attitude, then a route from that attitude.

reactions.name: Snap back
reactions.effect: Reverses along its own lane at 1.6x speed and leaves where it came in.

reactions.name: Frenzy
reactions.effect: 3 s of 1.5x speed with a hard side-to-side shake.

co_paths.name: Shadow
co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark follows 2-3 s behind in the same lane.

co_paths.name: Pincer
co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark takes the mirrored lane at the same moment, never touching.

co_paths.name: Hunting pair
co_paths.effect: Two Sharks swim the same route 1.5 s apart side by side, offset 0.12; only on Cruise or Patrol.

co_paths.name: Size-up
co_paths.effect: Two Sharks enter from opposite edges, stop 0.3 apart for 2 s facing each other, then the smaller one turns away.

co_paths.name: Food fight
co_paths.effect: Two Sharks dive at the same Sardine school from opposite sides; both leave as soon as it scatters.

co_paths.name: Standoff
co_paths.effect: One Shark holds a lane at the middle for 3 s while the other waits off screen; then they swap.

co_paths.name: Waiting holder
co_paths.effect: If the second Shark cannot get a lane, it circles just off screen (a fin shows at the edge) until the lane opens.

co_paths.name: Frenzy spreads
co_paths.effect: If one Shark goes into Frenzy, the second one speeds up 20% for 3 s (show only).
